notes:
Account context
- Copperfield Software is a mid-market SaaS company (support + KB product). They have a strict procurement policy: marketplace purchase required (AWS Marketplace). No exceptions approved so far.
- They are actively comparing ‘buy via AWS Bedrock’ vs ‘buy Redwood via AWS Marketplace’ mainly for procurement simplicity + invoice consolidation.

Deal snapshot
- Deal stage: Procurement.
- Buying committee: Procurement buyer + InfoSec reviewer + Eng lead for AI features.
- Expected close: March 2026 if marketplace path is clean.

Key asks (verbatim/paraphrase)
- “We can’t sign a separate order form outside AWS Marketplace.”
- “Give us SKU names that match what you meter. We got burned before with dimension mismatch.”
- “If entitlement takes hours, we need clear next steps and who to contact. Our dev team will churn if onboarding stalls.”

Procurement + packaging details
- Wants two paths:
  1) Hosted API usage-based via AWS Marketplace (metered dimensions must align to tokens/embeddings).
  2) Option to move to Dedicated capacity reservation if throughput grows; would prefer committed spend/contract rather than pure on-demand.
- They will likely request an AWS private offer once we confirm baseline usage, but they first need a public listing link and packaging clarity.

Security / compliance notes
- SOC 2: required (they accept ‘available under NDA’ but need an explicit statement in the security packet).
- Audit logs: want admin actions + API key events and export guidance (Splunk is their default SIEM).
- Retention: asked for default prompt/response retention and whether it is configurable by org.
- KMS: they asked specifically if customer-managed keys are supported and in which deployment modes (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). They will accept ‘customer-managed KMS available in Private/VPC; hosted uses platform-managed keys’ if stated clearly and consistently.

Onboarding concerns
- Their developer team wants a deterministic ‘subscription → entitlement → org provisioned’ path. They asked for documented retry guidance and a manual verification path (entitlement verification endpoint / support escalation) if entitlements lag.

Enablement materials sent / to send
- Sent (drafts): marketplace procurement one-pager + customer-facing marketplace FAQ.
- To send once final URLs are confirmed: security documentation pack index + marketplace onboarding docs landing page.

Internal guidance
- Keep messaging aligned with updated marketplace positioning; avoid over-claiming about key management in Hosted. Use approved phrasing from security packet.
- Confirm SKU/dimension mapping before giving procurement ‘final’ numbers; they explicitly mentioned prior vendor billing mismatch.

Open questions
- Which AWS region they will choose for inference (they prefer us-east-1 but asked about DR/region fallback).
- Whether they need Dedicated from day 1 or can start with Hosted and set guardrails (rate limits/quotas) to control spend.

Risks
- If our listing copy/URLs change during AWS review, procurement may stall. Keep them updated with the partner review tracker status.
- If entitlement delays occur in their first week, this will likely escalate directly to exec sponsor on their side.

- Markus: deliver a short technical note: expected entitlement propagation window, retry behavior, and support escalation path.
